errors.evidence: The x-axis in the chart extends to July 2025, not January 2025.
The x-axis is marked with half-yearly intervals (Jan., Jul.), not monthly intervals.
The x-axis is labeled with dates (e.g., 'Jan. 2015', 'Jul. 2015'). The text 'Januar 2015 = 100' is part of the legend, not a label on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie repräsentiert den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn
errors.evidence: The line representing the 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn' (statutory minimum wage) is purple, not blue.
The purple line for the statutory minimum wage reaches a value of exactly 150 in January 2025, not approximately 145.

errors.text_span: der im August 2023 einen Höchststand von etwa 138 erreicht
errors.evidence: The line for the statutory minimum wage is a step function that only increases; it does not have a peak ('Höchststand'). Furthermore, the value in August 2023 is approximately 141, not 138.
There is no yellow line in the chart. The description is referring to the light blue line.
The light blue line starts at an index value of 100 in January 2015, not 93.

errors.text_span: und im Januar 2025 bei etwa 137, wobei ein insgesamt zunehmender Trend erreicht wird, der sich im Februar 2023 auf etwa 133 erhöht
errors.evidence: The light blue line ends around July 2022. It does not extend to 2023 or 2025, so the reported values for these years are incorrect and refer to a non-existent part of this line.
There is no gray line in the chart. The description is referring to the dark blue line.
The dark blue line ends at a value of approximately 155 in January 2025. The value 141 is close to its starting point in late 2022, not its end point.

errors.text_span: und sich über den gesamten Zeitraum hinweg in einem vergleichsweise gleichmäßigen Bereich befindet
errors.evidence: This is inaccurate. The dark blue line shows a clear upward trend, increasing from about 141 to about 155. Describing it as being in a 'gleichmäßigen Bereich' (uniform range) is misleading.
